#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. 

Transforming data into decisions, are you ready to shape the future? As a System Analyst - Factory Integration you get ready to program the intelligence behind the chips, transform complex data into actionable insights, and create cutting-edge solutions that redefine industries and solve tomorrow's challenges. 

Are you in?

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Develop and maintain detailed software specifications and implement high-quality, scalable, and efficient code using Perl or other scripting language (e.g. Shell Scripting)

 * Design, develop and execute comprehensive unit tests, integration tests and system tests to ensure software meets quality, security, and performance standards

 * Provide IT operational support for Process Control Solutions and participate in a 24/7 support rotation for manufacturing solutions, as required

 * Perform ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting and optimization of software systems to ensure optimal performance, scalability and reliability

 * Work in cross-functional global teams and follow DevOps practices and methods 

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * A degree in Computer Engineering or a similar field of studies

 * 2+ years of hands-on software development experience using Perl or other scripting languages in a Linux environment

 * Proven track record of successfully planning, designing, and implementing complex systems

 * Knowledge of C# and Windows operating systems is considered a plus

 * Proficiency in agile development methods

 * Experience within the semiconductor industry is a significant plus, although not mandatory

 * Strong communication skills in English

We are filling this position through one of our leasing partners. A valid work permit for Austria (RWR+ Card) or EU citizenship is a prerequisite for this position. This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees of EEI with a minimum salary of € 3.888,53 (https://www.feei.at/leistungen/informations-service/mindestlohne-und-gehalter). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. A higher payment is negotiable depending on your expertise and skills.

Apply to this position online by following the URL and entering the Job ID in our job search.

ENPULSION GmbH is a Space Tech company based in Austria. Founded in 2016, it has quickly become a dominant player in the Space Industry selling one of the most advanced propulsion solutions for Small Sats to a large number of worldwide satellite platform integrators. The unique, modular solution we offer brings high performance at low cost to satellite manufacturers, fostering the democratization of space and enabling the exploration and exploitation of the solar system, positioning ENPULSION at the very heart of the New Space era.

We are currently seeking for a motivated employee for our Team, who will take over the duties and respons... 2 Production Employee (w/m/d) Job Overview:
ENPULSION is looking for a Production Employee (f/m/x) to join our Production team and support the assembly and production of satellite propulsion systems. This is a hands-on role where accuracy, reliability and quality are essential. You will work with small, high-precision components and follow clearly defined production processes.

The position is full-time and operates on a rotating two-shift schedule.

Key Responsibilities:

 * Assemble high-precision components according to work instructions
 * Carry out defined production processes and document production data
 * Prepare workstations, tools and equipment
 * Perform basic maintenance of laboratory equipment, including vacuum systems
 * Identify production issues and report deviations
 * Follow all quality and safety requirements
 * Support your colleagues and contribute to smooth daily production

Your profile:
 * Strong technical or manual interest (technical training in electronics, mechanics, or a comparable field is an advantage).
 * High attention to detail and excellent fine-motor skills.
 * Reliable, structured, and quality-focused way of working.
 * Ability to follow defined processes and instructions.
 * Good English skills are required.
 * Willingness to work in a rotating two-shift schedule.

Nice to have:

 * Experience working in a production, laboratory, or clean-room environment.
 * Technical training, such as a completed apprenticeship or HTL education, is helpful but not required.
 * Previous exposure to 2-shift operations.

Type of contract: 38.5 hours/week 

Salary: The minimum base salary for this position starts at EUR 2.727,40 gross per month, with a planned significant overpayment depending on your professional experience and qualifications.

Why us?
At ENPULSION, you'll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.

Our benefits include: 

 * 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional compulsory paid days off
